asset: v28/v28b isolated bear head and salmon geometric sculpt experiment
inspected: Actual four-angle Blender Cycles images for v28 and corrected v28b, independently parsed GLBs, verified exact SHA-256

bear_head_silhouette.reason: Entire original head is more connected than previous patched jaw, but front remains rounded and toy-like with dark hollow eyes and applied-looking nose.

salmon_head_body_silhouette.reason: Fish visibly has a fuller belly and tapered tail, and v28b shortened the fish by 21%. Gill/eye anatomy and fin shapes remain simplified; body resembles a smooth toy fish.

mouth_bite_legibility.reason: From the front the upper muzzle rests above a horizontal fish; lower jaw is a separate visible lump below but reads poorly as a real C-shaped bite. Local proximity alone does not solve it.

mesh_detail_and_integrity.reason: Both genuine Blender GLB primary meshes watertight with one connected component each, except small boolean scrap removed from bear head; 4 true Cycles angles recorded.

technical_validation.method: Blender 5.2.2 procedural mesh and real glTF GLB export plus Cycles render, independently checked with trimesh
technical_validation.note: Geometry contact metrics are not proof that mouth clamp looks correct. Original v28 before v28b also passed watertight QA.

artistic_review.scope: ONLY isolated head and salmon; no legs, full torso, fur details or textures in this artifact

defects.finding: Bear still looks like it has its muzzle resting on top of the fish; lower jaw visible beneath but does not convincingly enclose fish.
defects.fix: Use cross-section profile-matched side and frontal anatomical mouth with negative space actually visible, not only numerical closest-vertex distance.

defects.finding: Cranium still a round, toy-like loft. Large eye sockets appear empty and dark; muzzle and separate triangular nose are overly simplified.
defects.fix: Use multi-view artist sculpt and natural brow/ridge, not more consecutive rounded ring lofts.

defects.finding: Shorter fish has improved head/fish length ratio but still stylized, with simple blocky fins and nearly invisible gill cuts.
defects.fix: Reference-trace real salmon lateral head profile, operculum, lower jaw, dorsal/adipose/pectoral fins, and muscular caudal peduncle.

defects.finding: Early v28b ear and multimat experiments failed (disconnected ear islands, multi-primitive fish seam); final corrected version removed dark spots and cleaned an isolated 8-vertex mesh fragment.
defects.fix: Retain cleanup while avoiding edits that reintroduce disconnected components.

next_stage: Use verified multi-angle photographs/artist-guided digital sculpt, especially front/side bear jaw and realistic salmon head. New geometry must prove improvement in matching-perspective render before full-bear integration.
